title: Memory Games
shortDescription: The classic pairs game on a touchscreen, filled with the client's own pictures and stories, so visitors learn something about the brand while they search for matching cards.
longDescription: A digital pairs game for touchscreens and large displays. Visitors flip cards to find matching pairs, and each match can reveal a product, a person, a fact, or a short story behind it, turning a familiar game into a light way to share content. Rounds are short and easy to understand for all ages, and the game switches language at a tap. Card designs, the number of pairs, the content behind each match, timing, and the start and end screens are configurable to the brand. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Everyone Knows the Rules
highlights.description: Nobody needs instructions: visitors of any age start flipping cards right away, which keeps the barrier low and the queue moving.

highlights.title: A Story Behind Every Pair
highlights.description: Each match can open a short text or an image, so the game carries brand values, products, or employee stories that visitors would walk past on a poster.

highlights.title: Fits Into Any Exhibit
highlights.description: Runs on a touchscreen or display built into a shop, museum, or stand wall, with a restart button that resets it for the next visitor.

highlights.title: Harder, Faster, Together
highlights.description: Add a timer and a leaderboard, levels with more pairs, a two-player duel on one screen, or a prize for visitors who beat a target time.

highlights.title: Pairs for Every Story
highlights.description: Match products with their origins in a brand store, artworks with their artists in a museum, team members with their favourite quotes for an employer brand, or winter motifs in a festive edition.

highlights.title: Know What Gets Discovered
highlights.description: Add a data layer that tracks rounds played, completion times, and which pairs are revealed most, showing which content visitors actually engage with.

highlights.title: Play It Further
highlights.description: Pair with Prize Draw to reward the fastest players, with Visitor Identificator to keep each visitor's score, or with Cloud Content Management to swap cards and languages without new development.
